name: health-check
description: System diagnostics and self-healing planning tools to recover from errors without dead-end looping.

diagnose_system_health.description: Perform a 4-point system audit (Logs, Syntax, Processes, Memory) to plan a self-healing patch. NEVER use this in a loop; use it ONCE to build a plan.

error_id.description: The specific error code or message to investigate (e.g., 'ERR-144' or 'SyntaxError')

suspect_file.description: Optional: A specific file path to run syntax checks against
